sentences.text: Wunyelfia is a plesiosaur belonging to the family Elasmosauridae and the subfamily Aristonectinae, a parent group that includes other marine reptiles.
This genus contains only one known species, making it a rare find alongside Aristonectes quiriquinensis as one of just two plesiosaur species described from Chile.
The specific name maulensis honors the Región del Maule, specifically the Mariscadero coast north of Pelluhue, where the holotype specimen SGO.PV.6507 was recovered.
This single fossil consists of associated postcranial remains from one individual, providing a clear picture of its body structure.
Wunyelfia inhabited the oceans of central Chile during the Maastrichtian stage, a time period spanning from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
